narrative_row.outcomes: Two abnormal connectivity subnetworks identified (middle temporal gyrus/precuneus; emotion/empathy-linked k-partite network); SVM classification using these features achieved 89% (RBF) and 84% (linear) leave-one-out accuracy.

narrative_row.relevance_notes: Demonstrates a novel subnetwork-detection method on a well-characterised single ABIDE site, illustrating both an associational discovery step and a predictive validation step, useful as a methodological contrast to multi-site ABIDE classification studies.
